description: This file defines classes, functions, and constants related to engine control in an automotive EFI firmware project, including fuel scheduling, sensor states, engine state management, and knock detection.

classes.name: MockAdcState
classes.description: Manages mock ADC states for testing, including mock voltages and ADC values.

classes.name: FuelSchedule
classes.description: Handles scheduling of fuel injection events for engine cycles.

classes.name: ThermistorMath
classes.description: Performs thermistor temperature calculations based on resistance and configuration.

classes.name: SensorsState
classes.description: Maintains current sensor readings such as temperature, oil pressure, and accelerometer data.

classes.name: FuelConsumptionState
classes.description: Tracks fuel consumption metrics over time.

classes.name: WarningCodeState
classes.description: Tracks warning codes and warning states.

classes.name: EngineState
classes.description: Maintains engine operational data, including RPM, knock detection, and sensor states.

classes.name: FsioState
classes.description: Manages Fuel System I/O states and related flags.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Main class controlling engine operation, including fuel injection, ignition, and diagnostics.

classes.name: StartupFuelPumping
classes.description: Handles startup fuel pump logic based on TPS input.
